design_intent: 在不替换任何同济大学、设计创意学院或 iDVX Lab 官方识别的前提下，为帆布袋、笔记本、徽章建立一套年轻而克制的校园周边图像体系。方案以 design_system 的 Campus Data Grid 为统一语言，用公开 logo、官方校园语境与学术化排版共同传达“研究、秩序、活力、开放”，并以官方公开命名与归属关系作为信任锚点。

visual_direction.palette_strategy: Use design_system palette tokens by name: tongji-blue as primary institutional anchor, deep-ink for typography, paper-white for base field, steel-grid for secondary structure, signal-coral for limited youthful accents, campus-green only as support.
visual_direction.typography_strategy: Use design_system typography roles by name: display for hero titles, headline for product names, subhead for variant labels, body for short supporting lines, caption for institutional lockups, mono for edition/data details.
visual_direction.motif_strategy: Reuse design_system motif_system.name: Campus Data Grid on every merchandise composition as edge band, repeat pattern, or restrained background field.

copywriting_strategy.headline_principles: Follow an academic-restrained with youthful creative energy register, with behavior signals 年轻 / 创意 / 克制 / 学院感 / 研究导向: short bilingual product names, factual series labels, official institutional naming, and no hype, disruption language, or trend-slang.
copywriting_strategy.on_image_text_notes: 01 tote hero: “iDVX Lab / 同济大学设计创意学院”; 02 tote detail: “Campus Data Grid Series / 帆布袋”; 03 notebook cover: “Intelligent Big Data Visualization Lab”; 04 notebook open spread: “Research Notes / 研究记录”; 05 badge board: “徽章系列 / Badge Set”; 06 badge macro: “Edition 01”; 07 collection lineup: “Tote · Notebook · Badge”; 08 campus application: “Tongji University / iDVX Lab”. All copy is baked into the final PNGs.

deliverables.purpose: 帆布袋主视觉正面实物图，突出官方实验室标识与 Campus Data Grid 延展。
deliverables.acceptance_test: official-idvx-logo 清晰可辨且未变形；主色仅使用 tongji-blue / deep-ink / paper-white，允许少量 signal-coral；袋面出现 headline + caption 层级文案。

deliverables.purpose: 帆布袋局部/背面或肩带细节视图，展示纹样、走线和辅助信息层。
deliverables.acceptance_test: 可见 Campus Data Grid 作为辅助语言；logo 仍来自官方资产；mono 或 caption 信息层清晰；避免把 peer 参考版式直接照搬。

deliverables.purpose: 笔记本封面主视图，适合校内研究记录与访客纪念。
deliverables.acceptance_test: 封面结构遵循 12-column grid 感；出现官方中英文归属或实验室全称；tongji-blue 与 deep-ink 为主；Campus Data Grid 不喧宾夺主。

deliverables.purpose: 笔记本打开状态或内页系统视图，展示封面延展到内页索引/页眉。
deliverables.acceptance_test: 内页可见 mono 或 caption 体系与模块网格；纸面以 paper-white 为基底；细节克制、学术感强；不出现假论文或乱码文本。

deliverables.purpose: 徽章系列集合图，展示至少三枚变体及其统一语言。
deliverables.acceptance_test: 至少一枚徽章直接使用 official-idvx-logo；其余可用抽象 Campus Data Grid / campus contour 元素；颜色控制在 4 色内且小尺寸可辨识。

deliverables.purpose: 徽章特写图，强调工艺、边缘和年轻感点缀。
deliverables.acceptance_test: close-up 仍保持官方识别完整；signal-coral 只做小面积点缀；不得把徽章做成潮牌夸张金属件。

deliverables.purpose: 三类周边合影总览，用于总图与传播封面。
deliverables.acceptance_test: 帆布袋、笔记本、徽章三类全部入镜；系统 token 与 typography roles 统一；构图有策展感而非电商杂拍。

deliverables.purpose: 周边在同济校园语境中的应用图，强化校内归属。
deliverables.acceptance_test: 必须引用 official campus photo 作为 edit 参考；至少一件成品清晰可见；Tongji University / 同济大学语境成立；不得把校园变成陌生商拍场景。

deliverables.purpose: 单页策展式展厅，顶部说明设计系统，主体分区呈现帆布袋、笔记本、徽章、总览与校园应用图。
deliverables.acceptance_test: 内联 CSS、无 JS、无外链；页面顶部展示 palette swatches 与 typography roles；正文按 Tote / Notebook / Badge / Collection / Campus 分组嵌入全部 PNG，并在底部单独列出 Research Provenance references。

designer_constraints: must respect design_system.json (must-use) — every prompt cites the listed required_tokens hexes verbatim
Do not replace any existing official logo. official-idvx-logo remains the canonical lab mark.
Use the official organisation name exactly as cited in research/evidence.json (mirror it in design_system.lockup.string_zh / string_en).
Quote palette hex codes from design_system.palette.tokens verbatim in every image prompt — no paraphrasing, no nearby colors.
Name typography roles from design_system.typography.roles (display / headline / subhead / body / caption / mono) explicitly in every prompt.
Reuse design_system.motif_system.name on every deliverable that needs an auxiliary graphic language.
Avoid the listed AI design clichés (random gradients, glowing nodes, fake Latin, generic hex/brain/chip motifs).
Bake all copy into the rendered PNG; no separate copywriting.md is required.
no AI clichés (random gradients, glowing nodes, generic hex/brain motifs)
no SVG output; no per-deliverable HTML pages; only 00-gallery.html is HTML
do not synthesize a replacement for any research asset with do_not_replace=true
prefer image_edit whenever a reference asset is marked allowed_for_edit=true
open_questions_for_user: 若实验室内部另有未公开标准色或授权印刷规范，应在设计阶段覆盖公开网络推断。
